line-duel.observation_definition: [agent_pos, target_pos, opponent_pos, normalized_step, dist_target, dist_opponent, bias, slip_prob]
line-duel.observation_preprocessing: All positions and distances normalized to [0,1]; bias term included.
line-duel.reward_definition: +1.0 for reaching target, -1.0 if caught, -0.01 per step, small shaping toward target.
line-duel.episode_termination: Target reached, opponent catches agent, or max_steps reached.
line-duel.opponent_policy: Greedy one-step move toward agent with stochastic slip/no-move probability.
line-duel.stochasticity_sources: Initial positions and action slip controlled by seeded NumPy RNG.
line-duel.steps_to_T_definition: First interval at which mean evaluation score >= T, converted to environment-step cap units.
line-duel.timing_mode_definition: simulated_charged uses deterministic charged durations for scheduler stress tests; actual_cpu_clipped charges measured CPU time clipped to the declared atomic-step bounds.
line-duel.cross_layer_handoff: When enabled, RL candidates are injected into GA/PSO elite memories and GA/PSO teachers distill RL parameters within the selected atomic-step charge.

grid-treasure.observation_definition: [agent_xy, treasure_xy, chaser_xy, normalized_step, manhattan_treasure, manhattan_chaser, bias]
grid-treasure.observation_preprocessing: Coordinates and distances normalized to [0,1]; bias term included.
grid-treasure.reward_definition: +1.0 for treasure, -1.0 when caught, -0.01 per step, shaping toward treasure, random hazard penalty.
grid-treasure.episode_termination: Treasure reached, chaser catches agent, or max_steps reached.
grid-treasure.opponent_policy: Chaser greedily reduces Manhattan distance every other step with seeded randomness.
grid-treasure.stochasticity_sources: Initial positions, hazard penalty, and chaser tie-breaking controlled by seeded NumPy RNG.
grid-treasure.steps_to_T_definition: First interval at which mean evaluation score >= T, converted to environment-step cap units.
grid-treasure.timing_mode_definition: simulated_charged uses deterministic charged durations for scheduler stress tests; actual_cpu_clipped charges measured CPU time clipped to the declared atomic-step bounds.
grid-treasure.cross_layer_handoff: When enabled, RL candidates are injected into GA/PSO elite memories and GA/PSO teachers distill RL parameters within the selected atomic-step charge.

resource-defense.observation_definition: [resources, workers, soldiers, base_health, enemy_pressure, normalized_step, last_wave, cooldown, stockpile_ratio, defense_ratio, bias]
resource-defense.observation_preprocessing: Counts and health normalized to fixed caps; bias term included.
resource-defense.reward_definition: Incremental reward for survival, soldiers, and pressure reduction; penalties for base damage and defeat; terminal win bonus if base survives.
resource-defense.opponent_policy: Seeded enemy pressure process with stochastic waves; pressure damages base unless countered by soldiers/attack actions.
resource-defense.stochasticity_sources: Initial stockpile, enemy wave arrivals, and wave magnitudes controlled by seeded NumPy RNG.
resource-defense.steps_to_T_definition: First interval at which mean evaluation score >= T, converted to environment-step cap units.
resource-defense.timing_mode_definition: simulated_charged uses deterministic charged durations for scheduler stress tests; actual_cpu_clipped charges measured CPU time clipped to the declared atomic-step bounds.
resource-defense.cross_layer_handoff: When enabled, RL candidates are injected into GA/PSO elite memories and GA/PSO teachers distill RL parameters within the selected atomic-step charge.
